dir=${0%/*}

moddir=${dir%/*}
id=${moddir##*/}
run=$dir/run

case "$(uname -m)" in
  aarch64 | arm64) abi=arm64-v8a ;;
  x86_64) abi=x86_64 ;;
  *) echo "flutter_webui: unsupported CPU $(uname -m)" >&2; exit 1 ;;
esac

(umask 077 && mkdir -p "$TMPDIR" "$run")
